utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Memory tool fix is merged. The parent directory creation now uses os.makedirs with exist_ok. Path traversal issue is filed as a follow-up. Moving on.

utterances.speaker: Packy Gallagher
utterances.text: Streaming refactor: I've extracted retry into a new RetryPolicy class. The Stream and AsyncStream classes in _streaming.py now compose it instead of inlining the exponential backoff. Around 200 lines smaller. Felix has the API question.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: Spike done. We should support both — sync and async retry policies. Most users will use the async one but the new sandboxed memory tool path needs sync. I've sent the design doc, can someone review?

utterances.speaker: Qing Wang
utterances.text: Stainless codegen landed. I'm unblocked on agents. Picking up the test suite for beta_session_runner today, should be done tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tomer Aberbach
utterances.text: From the Stainless side — we shipped a fix for the type generation on optional union fields. That was breaking the agents resource. Let me know if anything else looks off.

utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Decision: Felix, you own the RetryPolicy sync/async surface. We'll go dual API. Packy, please pair with him on the API shape before merging the refactor. Release on track for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: One more thing — _streaming.py has 3 places where we still catch a bare Exception. I want to narrow those before the release. Action item.
